steps.evidence: General procedure B was applied to 2-methyl-7-(trimethylsilyl)quinoline (215 mg, 1.00mmol).
The reaction was stirred at room temperature for 72hours
Volatiles were removed under reduced pressure
the remaining residue was purified by silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5%  over  25 column   volumes
